# draw

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/draw"
```

Package draw renders the frame: text fitting, panels, header, tabs, status and overlay compositing. Everything measures screen cells, truncates, and never wraps, so callers can count rows and get the terminal's answer.

## func [Button](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/widgets.go#L27>)

```go
func Button(label string, st ButtonStyle, focused bool) string
```

Button is a filled label in st.Focused when focused, st.Blurred otherwise. Dialogs draw their answers with it; a form draws its submit with it.

<a name="Card"></a>
## func [Card](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/widgets.go#L37>)

```go
func Card(r layout.Rect, title, body, footer string, st PanelStyle) string
```

Card is a Panel whose last row is footer, set off from the body by a rule: a block of facts with what can be done about them underneath.

<a name="Composite"></a>
## func [Composite](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/composite.go#L12>)

```go
func Composite(fg, bg string, x, y int) string
```

Composite draws fg over bg at \(x, y\), replacing only the cells it covers and keeping the rest of each bg line, escapes included. This is what lets a modal float over the panes instead of blanking them.

<a name="FitBlock"></a>
## func [FitBlock](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/text.go#L74>)

```go
func FitBlock(s string, width, height int) string
```

FitBlock cuts a block to height rows and width cells per row. A too\-wide line would wrap inside lipgloss and push a border down, so cut first.

<a name="Panel"></a>
## func [Panel](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/panel.go#L42>)

```go
func Panel(r layout.Rect, edges Edges, body string, st PanelStyle) string
```

Panel draws a box exactly r.W by r.H with edges drawn into its border. Below three rows only the top edge is drawn; below four columns nothing is.

<a name="Sanitize"></a>
## func [Sanitize](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/safe.go#L12>)

```go
func Sanitize(s string) string
```

Sanitize renders server\-supplied text so drawing it can only draw: OSC 52 sets the clipboard, CSI forges a confirmation modal, bidi \(CVE\-2021\-42574\) reorders a line. Rendering only \- the clipboard still sees the real bytes.

<a name="SanitizeLines"></a>
## func [SanitizeLines](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/safe.go#L45>)

```go
func SanitizeLines(s string) []string
```

SanitizeLines handles legitimately multi\-line text \- a policy, a role's configuration \- keeping the breaks and neutralising the rest. A trailing carriage return is CRLF and not content, so a Windows document reads clean.

<a name="Wrap"></a>
## func [Wrap](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/text.go#L45>)

```go
func Wrap(s string, width int) []string
```

Wrap folds plain text into rows of at most width cells, breaking after spaces and hyphens and cutting a word wider than a row. Newlines stay; style the rows after wrapping, since a style is not re\-opened per row.

<a name="ButtonStyle"></a>
## type [ButtonStyle](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/widgets.go#L21-L23>)

ButtonStyle paints a button: Focused the one enter would press, Blurred the rest. The theme fills both from its palette, with the same padding so focus never moves a button.

```go
type ButtonStyle struct {
    Focused, Blurred lipgloss.Style
}
```

<a name="ChromeStyle"></a>
## type [ChromeStyle](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/chrome.go#L13-L20>)

ChromeStyle colours the rows around the panes.

```go
type ChromeStyle struct {
    Title     lipgloss.Style // header title
    Info      lipgloss.Style // header subtitle and right-hand text
    Tab       lipgloss.Style
    TabActive lipgloss.Style
    Status    lipgloss.Style
    Dim       lipgloss.Style // empty-state message and hint
}
```

<a name="DividerStyle"></a>
## type [DividerStyle](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/chrome.go#L117-L119>)

DividerStyle paints a Divider: Line the rule, Label the text set into it.

```go
type DividerStyle struct {
    Line, Label lipgloss.Style
}
```

<a name="Edges"></a>
## type [Edges](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/panel.go#L27-L31>)

Edges is what a panel draws into its border besides the lines.

```go
type Edges struct {
    Title, Right string        // the top edge; Right is dropped before Title is cut
    Bottom       string        // the far end of the bottom edge, dropped when it does not fit
    Scroll       layout.Scroll // a thumb on the right edge; the zero value draws none
}
```

<a name="PanelStyle"></a>
## type [PanelStyle](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/panel.go#L15-L21>)

PanelStyle colours a panel: Border inks the edges, Title the label in the top edge, Right the text at the far end of either edge, Thumb a scrollbar's thumb. Edge is the box\-drawing set, rounded when zero.

```go
type PanelStyle struct {
    Border lipgloss.Style
    Title  lipgloss.Style
    Right  lipgloss.Style
    Thumb  lipgloss.Style
    Edge   lipgloss.Border
}
```
